text:
Anya: Heads-up - client 'Solaris Labs' hit a batch of declines after our token migration. Cards declined with 'acct_mismatch' and ACH microdeposit returned 'account_not_found'. Can payments ops triage?
Brett: Which invoice/charges?
Anya: INV-2102, charges ch_08MNOP... x3. Last4 4012, 5101. Token migration ID: migr-2026-03.
Dina: Migration might have stripped payer name or account metadata. I'm checking token payloads.
Brett: Pause autopay retries for that merchant_id so we don't keep failing. Kasia, finance ok to accept wire while we investigate?
Kasia: Yes — waive one late fee if remittance comes within 48h. Need remittance screenshot + payer name before marking paid.
PaymentsBot: autopay_suspended set for solaris-labs.
Dina: Confirmed token payloads lost 'billing_contact'. Opening infra ticket INF-7103 to roll back tokenizer patch for affected batch.
Anya: I'll DM the account and offer wire + virtual card. Send wire template and request remittance.
ZendeskBot: Created ticket Z#12777 for Solaris Labs payment failure.
Brett: I patched billing-worker to tag failures with "acct_mismatch" and skip retries for 7 days. Deployed.
Kasia: Wire template (internal): Bank: Silicon Valley Bank; Account: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Acct#: 7766554433; ABA: 121140399; SWIFT: SVBKUS6S; Reference: Solaris-INV-2102.
Anya: Sent to customer and asked for payment ETA. Also added note in ticket about waiver.
Dina: Rollback plan queued; ETA 30m. Will re-run token migration with corrected metadata and requeue ACH verification after rollback.
Brett: Once wire posts, finance ops mark invoice.status='settled-wire' and cancel pending retries. Attach remittance to Z#12777.
PaymentsBot: Monitor set: escalate to oncall if >3 failed attempts in 6h for solaris-labs.
Kasia: Finance watching for remittance. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
